items.coder_A: not_glioblastoma (flagged: Arm B may admit grade IV glioma without IDH requirement)
items.reason: Glioblastoma is never named; the trial is framed as an IDH-mutant glioma study (conditions "Glioma, Malignant; IDH Mutation"; summary "patients with IDH-mutant glioma"), and the recurrent route requires "histologically confirmed IDH-mutant glioma". R7 requires no IDH requirement, which is not met here. However, the newly diagnosed route admits "suspected high grade glioma" before IDH status is known, so IDH-wildtype grade 4 tumours are not formally excluded.

note: Low practical impact: the record is EARLY_PHASE1, so it can enter only the translational subset (D23), never the primary estimand. The S5 question is whether an IDH-mutant-targeted window study whose newly diagnosed arm admits radiographically suspected high-grade glioma (IDH status unknown at entry) counts as IDH-mutant-only (not_glioblastoma) or as R7 historical grade 3-4 glioma (mixed_glioma_gbm_named). The IDH-mutant requirement on the recurrent route and in conditions argues against R7. If XL includes it, the IDH-mutant match to DSP-0390 (both coders: candidate_matched=true, stated hypothesis 'alterations in cholesterol metabolism driven by mutant IDH will increase susceptibility to DSP-0390') would be a positive primary outcome needing D21 review; its scope is the recurrent route only.
